arguments.name: enc
arguments.text: NULL or "" for the default, or one encoding name.

origin.details: The record holds the friendly name, the canonical ICU name, names under each standard, whether ASCII bytes 1..127 map to themselves, whether bytes 32..255 round-trip, and the minimum and maximum character sizes. An unknown name is an error.
origin.example: cat(paste0("stri_enc_info(\"UTF-8\") reports the friendly name ", stri_enc_info("UTF-8")$Name.friendly, ".\n"))

arguments.name: enc
arguments.text: None or "" for the default, or one encoding name.

translation.details: Missing standard names are NA. ASCII.subset is whether bytes 1..127 map to themselves. Unicode.1to1 is whether bytes 32..255 round-trip, and it is NA when the converter is not 8-bit. An unknown name raises ValueError with the ICU file-access message.
translation.value: A dict. Missing names are NA.
translation.example:
from stringi.encoding import stri_enc_info
print(f"stri_enc_info(\"UTF-8\") reports the friendly name {stri_enc_info('UTF-8')['Name.friendly']}.")
